item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star, has died at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.

item.title: Local author helps others struggling with eating disorders
item.description: National Eating Disorders Awareness Week is Feb. 23 through March 1, but one local woman has made it her mission to spread awareness and help others far beyond just one week a year.

item.description: Watch Honoring Black History this Friday, Feb. 20, at 6:30 p.m. on FOX Providence, the WPRI 12+ smart TV app, and right here on WPRI.com.

item.title: All 22,000 RI employees to receive corrected W-2 forms after 'umbrella company' mistake
item.description: The R.I. Department of Administration said it will be sending corrected forms to every employee.

item.description: Good Friday Morning. Dry skies will continue during the overnight and into early Friday morning. item.title: Johnston man accused of stealing 3 town-owned snowplows
item.description: The alleged thefts happened early Wednesday morning at Johnston War Memorial Park on Hartford Avenue, police said.

item.title: Photographer captured victims' final family moments before deadly shooting
item.description: "When I think about that and I look at those photographs, it obviously brings me back to that moment and makes my heart really ache," Chip DeLorenzo said.

item.title: 'That's a hero': Good Samaritan recalls how Pawtucket shooting victim tried to protect his mother
item.description: When a man turned a gun on his family at the Dennis M Lynch Arena in Pawtucket on Monday and started shooting, several people in the stands jumped into action to try and save lives. Ryan Cordeiro was one of those good Samaritans.

item.title: Rhode Island Hospital released wrong body to funeral home
item.description: A family is suing Rhode Island Hospital and Bell Funeral Home after claiming the wrong body was buried at their mother's funeral.

item.title: Mother trapped alive with dead son weeks before bodies found outside hospital
item.description: The elderly homeless woman called a friend, telling them her son had died two days before and she could not get out of the car.
